decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out several products that were actually accessories like cases, batteries, and chargers. For the speakers, I selected a consideration set that spans budget (INSMY), mid-range (JBL, Bose), and premium (Harman Kardon, Sony) categories. The JBL Flip 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_166) is the final choice because it maintains an impressively high 4.8-star rating over a massive review base of nearly 69,000 users. At $89.95, it represents the most reliable value for a portable waterproof speaker, especially compared to the Sony RA3000 which had some concerns regarding its app, and the Harman Kardon which, while high quality, is much more expensive and heavy.
